title: Technique
description: The contract for ONE item of src/data/techniques.json, an array of how-to techniques (how to cut, fold, shape) shown in a popup from a recipe step and on the Learning to Cook page. Enforced at build time by scripts/validate-recipes.mjs, which reads the rules below. A recipe step references a technique by id (recipe.schema.json, instructions[].technique). 'Used in' is derived from those references and never stored.

id.description: Stable, unique id. It is the anchor on the Learning to Cook page (/learning-to-cook/#<id>) and what recipe steps reference.

kicker.description: The small label above the title, e.g. "Knife work · Vegetables".

src.description: Path to the SVG, relative to public/ with no leading slash. At most 150 KB, no script or event-handler attributes, and a PNG companion beside it (node scripts/rasterize-diagrams.mjs). See docs/internal/adding-a-diagram.md.

alt.description: Text alternative that conveys what the diagram teaches, not just what it shows.

how.description: The steps, in order. Shown as an ordered list.

why.description: Why it is done this way, one or two sentences. Shown in muted italic.
